Ghazal 92

7 divan verses (out of 10); meter G5; rhyming elements: iir nahii;N
composed 1821; Arshi #89

-- transliteration -- meter: G5 -- dating -- texts -- commentators --
-- modern: Hamid p. 75 -- full: Raza 1995 p. 359 --
-- an early manuscript version: the Nuskhah-e Hamidiyah, c.1821, Anvar ul-Haq edition, pp. 113-114 --

{92,1}

maana((-e dasht-navardii ko))ii tadbiir nahii;N
ek chakkar hai mire paa;Nv me;N zanjiir nahii;N

{92,2}

shauq us dasht me;N dau;Raa))e hai mujh ko kih jahaa;N
jaadah ;Gair az nigah-e diidah-e ta.sviir nahii;N

{92,3}

;hasrat-e la;z;zat-e aazaar rahii jaatii hai
jaadah-e raah-e vafaa juz dam-e shamshiir nahii;N

{92,4}

ranj-e naumiidii-e jaaved gavaaraa rahyo
;xvush huu;N gar naalah zabuunii-kash-e taa;siir nahii;N

{92,5}

sar khujaataa hai jahaa;N za;xm-e sar achchhaa ho jaa))e
la;z;zat-e sang bah andaazah-e taqriir nahii;N

{92,6}

jab karam ru;x.sat-e bebaakii-o-gustaa;xii de
ko))ii taq.siir bah juz ;xajlat-e taq.siir nahii;N

{92,7}

;Gaalib apnaa yih ((aqiidah hai bah qaul-e naasi;x
aap be-bahrah hai jo mu((taqid-e miir nahii;N

An unpublished verse from this ghazal:

{92,8x}

miir ke shi((r kaa a;hvaal kahuu;N kyaa ;Gaalib
jis kaa diivaan kam az gulshan-e kashmiir nahii;N
